艾米的生活方式(Amy's Way of Living): 一篇关于生活服务的B1记叙文:艾米的经历、感受与成长。

At first, Amy found it difficult to keep the habit. The community center looked quieter than usual that evening. The experience taught Amy more than any book could. Extroverts enjoy meeting new people.
Little by little, things began to change. There are always more possibilities than we expect. Amy wrote down every idea in a small notebook. They store old boxes in the basement.

Amy will take part in a basketball match in July. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Amy believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. For example, they booked an intercontinental flight from London to Tokyo.

Amy prefers snowy weather when running in the supermarket. The post office has become an important part of daily life. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. The towels are still in the dryer.
There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Grace always says that small steps matter more than big plans. Amy usually spends the weekend reading at the supermarket.
